title: Argumentative Debates for Transparent Bias Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing local and global conditional probabilities of positive classifications across racial groups (e.g., African-American vs. others) within K-nearest neighborhoods using a Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework (QBAF) to structure debates on the COMPAS dataset.

Evaluating differences in success probabilities for female individuals within local neighborhoods and globally using the ABIDE argumentation framework, tested on synthetic models (Adult Census Income dataset) and the COMPAS dataset.

Assessing disparities in positive outcome probabilities across different age groups (e.g., Young/Old vs. MidAge) using local statistical parity and argumentative debates on the Bank Marketing dataset.

Detecting predictive biases by comparing conditional success probabilities across varying marital statuses (Married, Single, Divorced) using the QBAF-based debate framework on the Bank Marketing dataset.
